name: Herdr
author: Majkelll
description: Everything you need for herdr in the bar, and nothing you don't: every server on this machine and over SSH, every agent in herdr's own colours, a badge for the one waiting on you, and one click to its session. Read-only towards herdr, no elevated privileges.

barWidget.description: herdr servers and agents on this machine and over SSH, in herdr's own colours, one click from their session.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often every machine is asked what it is holding while the panel is closed. Each poll is one ssh round trip per remote machine, on a connection that is kept open between polls. An idle herd is asked half as often, because nothing in it can change until you change it.

schema.label: Refresh interval while open (seconds)
schema.description: How often the same question is asked while the panel is on screen, where an agent that starts waiting on you should show up quickly.
